G3 is chaperonin protein folding itself; tubulin-modification and cilium/spindle groups are downstream tubulin-pool contexts.
TYSND1 is part of peroxisomal matrix protein import/maturation (G5) and loosely relates to the beta-oxidation and ether-lipid pathways whose enzymes it processes.
CTD Ser5 phosphorylation sits in Pol II promoter escape/early elongation (G1, G3) and also in co-transcriptional mRNA capping/processing (G2).
Drug-reward behaviour groups, dopamine signalling, and nicotinic receptor groups show behavioural versus receptor-mechanism aspects of nicotine response.
CD1 fits lipid antigen presentation (G1) and DC/monocyte surface-identity signatures (G3, G2, G4), distinct functional vs marker aspects.
SLC26 anion-exchanger family (G2), bicarbonate/SLC-defect transport (G1, G3) and epithelial salt/chloride transport physiology (G4) are different angles.
T cell activation modules and proximal TCR/costimulation/checkpoint signalling all describe the same TCR-driven activation step; chemotaxis group does not fit.
Fits NF-kB-pathway inborn immunodeficiencies (G1), canonical IKK activation mechanism (G2), and loosely TCR-to-NF-kB and noncanonical/EDA-ID contexts; B cell identity group does not fit.
NPC assembly/maintenance (G1), nucleocytoplasmic transport through pores (G2) and nuclear envelope organisation (G3) are distinct aspects.
T cell activation/TCR signalling groups are the core home, while G1 represents the NF-kB signalling arm in general.
Extravasation, integrin/PECAM1 adhesion and chemotactic homing all describe the same leukocyte transendothelial migration cascade.
Tooth/amelogenesis groups (G1, G4) versus phosphate mineral handling (G2) and CFTR/anion transport (G3) show developmental vs ion-transport aspects.
Peroxisomal fatty-acid oxidation (G4) is the core, with TPP-cofactor (HACL1) vitamin metabolism (G3) and broader lipid/mitochondrial catabolism as other aspects.
NEK/PLK1/AURKA mitotic entry and spindle-assembly groups all capture the same mitotic spindle-formation role; G4 adds checkpoint signalling loosely.
Nectin trans-heterodimerization is core adhesion, while neural wiring/guidance (G1) and paranodal/nodal axon organisation (G3) are contexts of heterophilic adhesion.
Regulation of UPR-to-apoptosis switching (G3), adaptive UPR (G2) and beta-cell survival context (G1) are different aspects.
Glycosphingolipid biosynthesis is the core, with sialylation/glycan elongation, ganglioside catabolism and lipid transport as distinct aspects.
Lung branching/organ development (G1, G3) versus generic mesenchymal proliferation and epithelial-mesenchymal signalling (G2) are organ vs cell-signalling aspects.
APP processing/amyloid formation and clearance groups versus glial neuroinflammation and neurotoxic-response groups show production vs disease-consequence aspects.
